decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp, large U-axis step near index 630 with correlated N/E transients, likely a permanent or long-lasting offset; (2) a broader, multi-axis asymmetric dip near index 435–445 with incomplete recovery, possibly a temporary deformation. Other intervals show typical noise or smooth trends without compelling morphological anomalies.

regions.observation: Sharp, multi-sample downward step in U (≈−20 MAD) at index ~630–635, preceded by modest noise and followed by a sustained lower platform; N and E show smaller but correlated transient shifts around the same interval, suggesting a possible co-located offset or deformation event.

Broad, asymmetric dip in N (centered ~435–445) with partial recovery, accompanied by a shallower opposing dip in E and a delayed, smaller U response—suggesting a possible temporary deformation or loading/unloading with ambiguous return; the shape is not smooth noise and spans >10 samples across axes.
